verdict.rationale: Turso is a database platform, not an agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Turso publishes an MCP server that external agents connect to. That server-side capability does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
